intro: Sifting through loose dirt in Dustwallow Marsh, you find an orc's severed hand clutching a tube carved from bone, with a dirt-stained parchment inside. It is a report written by an orc who watched Theramore as a spy for weeks, and it is meant for Nazeer Bloodpike, the orcs' spymaster at Brackenwall Village.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: Sifting through the loose dirt, the severed hand of an orc is found. And clutched in the hand is a bone-carved tube. And in the tube is a dirt-stained parchment.
The parchment is a report made by an orc who spent weeks spying on the city of Theramore.
After scanning the parchment, it is clear that it must be brought to the orc spymaster in Brackenwall Village.

clips.title: Completion
paras: Good work, friend. Our agent, Marg Nighteye, was stationed outside Theramore. He was charged to spy on the city.
This is his latest report, and it may be his last -- from your testimony, I fear that Marg met his end in the swamp...
